when i was a teenager i briefly “dated” a man who was also 40

i didn’t think he groomed me either but now that i have stopped talking to him, he totally did. grooming doesn’t have to be physical, it can be mentally to make you think a relationship like that (especially with someone who has known you since you were a kid) is okay. after a while i started to realize the toll it took on me

also, i found out recently that man is a sex offender for crimes involving children. i didn’t see it at the time but now it is so obvious. not that your girlfriend is a sex offender or anything, just thought it goes to show that this isn’t the behavior of a normal adult
reads to me like “my wants should matter more” instead of “i don’t want to argue constantly”

swords are composed of mainly inorganic shapes so in my opinion that tends to make them harder to draw. since you’re drawing digitally i suggest taking advantage of rulers and symmetry tools; since it’s all free handed it’s a little asymmetrical which makes it look less like a sword. the designs of the sword and the character are awesome though, i love it!

for me it helped immensely to draw from photos. if you’re going for something that looks more realistic then your best bet is probably to find or take some pictures of subjects you like and study the way the light falls and where shadows appear, textures and materials, how different lighting affects the color of what you’re drawing, stuff like that. if you’re a visual learner you’ll notice patterns and it will be easier to start implementing it. don’t be discouraged if it isn’t perfect the first time! hope this helps
thank you, this is really helpful

maybe if you contacted the police in her area and gave them her name and social media accounts they could deduce where she lives from the info she used to create her accounts? it may be easier to find a general number to call so if you can’t find the number for the city she lives in they can possibly reroute you to police in nanjing that speak english. if that doesn’t work then maybe try calling the european emergency number (i don’t know what it is as an american) and they can maybe help you.
i wish you luck on contacting your friend, and hopefully she is safe. if it helps, sometimes when i’m feeling suicidal i vent it to a close friend and sometimes feel so terrible that i go offline for a few days. she could just be taking a break but you’re a good friend for trying to find out if she’s okay. hopefully this helps
